test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The traffic lights at three different road crossings change after every 48 seconds, 72 seconds and 108 seconds, respectively. If they all change simultaneously at 8:20 hours, then at what time will they again change simultaneously?
solution:
**Given:**

The traffic lights at three different road crossings change after every 48 seconds, 72 seconds and 108 seconds, respectively.

They all change simultaneously at 8:20 hours.

**Calculations:**

The light will change simultaneously again at the lowest common possible time of all lights together,

i.e., LCM(48, 72 and 108)

= 432 seconds

= 432/60 = 7.20 minutes = 0 : 7 : 12 hours

So, The time at which all lights will change simultaneously again is 

= 8 : 20 + 0 : 7 : 12

= 8 : 27 : 12 hours

**Hence, the required time is 8 : 27 : 12 hours.**
